item.title: PyPad 1.8.4
item.description: - PyPad 1.8.4 improves reliability across Offline Writing Studio, QR generation, settings search highlighting, and hidden developer-mode activation. - Offline Writing Studio now times out slow local LanguageTool warmup and falls back to rule-based analysis instead of hanging the app. - Currency Converter replaces the older cached-currency naming and now supports manual live-rate refresh with offline-safe fallback. - QR generation now emits scanner-friendly output with a proper quiet zone and cleaner saved-image scaling. - The Windows uninstaller now asks whether to preserve or delete PyPad-managed local settings and app data. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
